income-tax.summary: US income tax is federal plus state (and sometimes city). There is no single US rate. Ask which state before saying anything numeric.

facts.note: Progressive federal brackets. Do not quote a bracket from memory.
Nine states have no general income tax; the rest do. Name the state or refuse the number.

payroll.summary: US payroll is federal withholding, Social Security, Medicare, plus state unemployment and withholding. The books (Gusto, ADP, QuickBooks, Xero US) hold the live figures.

facts.note: Social Security wage base changes every year. Read the payroll run, do not invent it.

sales-tax.summary: There is no federal VAT. Sales tax is state and local. Nexus rules decide whether you collect.

facts.note: Do not apply UK VAT to a US invoice.
